Idempotent: deactivating an already-deactivated path is a no-op success and does NOT republish ProcessPathDeactivated. Publishes ProcessPathDeactivated the first time a path transitions to Deactivated. This service takes no position on work already assigned to this path in a downstream context — that is each consumer's own operational concern.
